findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_config, get_product_templates, create_config_session, update_config_session, get_session_latest, get_file_upload_url, add_to_cart, analyze_file, get_file_session_proofs, create_proof · Private data: get_product_templates, create_file_session, link_file_session, clone_file_session, list_session_files, get_file_upload_url, add_to_cart, analyze_file, get_file_analysis, get_file_session_analysis, recommend_products, get_file_session_proofs, create_proof, create_file_check, set_proof_approval · Public sink: update_config_session, list_session_files, get_file_upload_url, analyze_file · Destructive: get_product_templates, update_config_session, add_to_cart, get_file_session_proofs, create_file_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_config, get_product_templates, create_config_session, update_config_session, get_session_latest, get_file_upload_url, add_to_cart, analyze_file, get_file_session_proofs, create_proof · Private data: get_product_templates, create_file_session, link_file_session, clone_file_session, list_session_files, get_file_upload_url, add_to_cart, analyze_file, get_file_analysis, get_file_session_analysis, recommend_products, get_file_session_proofs, create_proof, create_file_check, set_proof_approval · Public sink: update_config_session, list_session_files, get_file_upload_url, analyze_file · Destructive: get_product_templates, update_config_session, add_to_cart, get_file_session_proofs, create_file_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
